name: DREO Solaris 718
summary: A slim 1,500 W tower heater with a digital thermostat in 1°F steps and a remote. Four independent hands-on tests agree it warms a small room quickly, and CNN Underscored measured it at 41 dB at its loudest. It's almost 30 in tall, and DREO's warranty is only one year.
idealFor: Most studios and one-bedroom living rooms
Anyone who wants a quiet heater with a real thermostat and a remote
pros: Warmed the area in front of it by 21°F in 15 minutes in CNN Underscored's test
Quietest fan heater CNN measured here: 41 dB on its loudest setting
Digital thermostat from 41 to 95°F in 1°F steps, remote and child lock
Tip-over switch beeps, then cuts power about 20 seconds after it falls (CNN)
cons: Almost 30 in tall, and the conical shape didn't suit every tester
The remote uses symbols only, with no text labels (Bob Vila, The Gadgeteer)
DREO recalled a different heater, the DR-HSH015, on Oct 29, 2026

trust.summary: Four independent hands-on tests agree it heats a small room quickly and quietly, and none reports a defect. DREO publishes full specs, materials and warnings, an address and a clear claim process. It loses 8 points because DREO recalled another heater in October 2026, 8 because we couldn't verify a UL or ETL listing in a public directory, and 3 for a 1-year warranty.

sources.title: CNN Underscored: The best space heaters
sources.note: Best space heater. 234 sq ft room, sensors at 3 and 10 ft for 60 min: +21°F in front of it in 15 min without oscillation (11°F with), 95°F at 15 min and 101°F at 1 hr on highest; 41 dB at its loudest; tip-over beeps, then shuts off 20 s after falling; grille doesn't get too hot

sources.title: Family Handyman: The 6 safest space heaters, tested and reviewed
sources.note: Best overall. Dylan Fischer, rooms of 169–196 sq ft, 4–6 hours per heater: 10°F difference in the center of the room on high; low mode nearly silent; grates took a few minutes to cool after high heat; disliked the conical shape and vague setup directions

sources.title: Bob Vila: Is the Solaris 718 worth it?
sources.note: Glenda Taylor, Sept 27, 2024, at home in a 216 sq ft room: 60°F to 70°F in just under 30 minutes on high; highest mode sounds like white noise; remote has symbols only

sources.title: HGTV: 7 best space heaters of 2026, tested and reviewed
sources.note: Best overall. Kamron Sanders, photos dated Mar 31, 2026; tipped units over while running to check the shutoff; notes no large-room heater reached its claimed 300–400 sq ft
